_about: Every retired name of a faction, order, house, company, crew, ruling body or office in the story, with what replaced it or that it was cut. The one home of these renames: tools/newworld/consistency.py (family 'names', rules in docs/design/consistency-rules.md) fails any live file that uses a retired name outside its allowed sense. A row's 'match' patterns are Python regular expressions, case-insensitive unless 'case' is true; a line matching one of its 'allow' patterns is the allowed sense; 'allow_paths' are path globs where the row does not apply. 'scope' says which paths are live; 'owed' lists live paths still carrying a retired name, each with the work that clears it, reported and not failing until that work lands (the check then fails until the path leaves the list).
